question: What is the largest single-second average speed drop (m/s) on edge 113? For each pair of consecutive simulation seconds (t, t+1) where edge 113 has at least one vehicle in BOTH seconds, compute: drop = avg_speed(t) - avg_speed(t+1). Only consecutive seconds count (t and t+1 must differ by exactly 1). Report the maximum drop value (positive means deceleration). Answer format: <number> rounded to 2 decimal places
